text: DSH Model Advanced Configuration 是一个用于 DSH Web 客户端的模型高级设置页面插件。它在设置导航中添加“模型高级配置”入口，并通过连接 API 读取提供方目录和设置 schema，按 schema 显示可编辑字段。用户可调整提供方的超时、传输、缓存和请求头等选项，也可编辑模型目录中的上下文窗口、最大输出、视觉输入及推理级别映射；保存时提交最小路径变更。适合需要为不同提供方或模型补充高级能力配置的 DSH Web 用户。插件不要求额外 API 密钥；密钥状态只以凭据配置标记显示。

DSH Model Advanced Configuration adds a settings page to DSH web. It discovers editable fields from provider schemas for provider options and model values such as context size, output limit, vision, and reasoning. Saving submits changed paths only. No extra API key is required.
我想给不同模型分别设置上下文长度和最大输出。
DSH 网页端能在哪里改提供方的超时和请求头？
How can I edit per-model vision and reasoning settings in the DSH web UI?
DSH Model Advanced Configuration 的功能「提供方高级设置」：按提供方 schema 展示可编辑字段，包括超时、传输、缓存和请求头。选择提供方后编辑字段，保存时只提交发生变化的设置路径。
DSH Model Advanced Configuration 的功能「模型目录与能力编辑」：编辑模型条目及其上下文窗口、最大输出、视觉输入和推理映射。通过模型列表控件修改条目，再保存设置变更。
DSH Model Advanced Configuration reads credential status only; API key secrets are not fetched or rewritten.

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced：> **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

DSH web plugin: a schema-driven **Model Advanced** settings page. Registers one
`settings.section` nav entry (`model-advanced`, order 11) beside the shipped
Models page: a per-provider and per-model editor for the advanced capability
fields the Models page does not render (vision input, context window, max
output, reasoning level map, timeouts, transport, cache, headers,
openai-completions compat switches).

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced：Everything the editor addresses is probed out of the serialized schemastery
envelope of the provider's own settings namespace, so a schema that lacks a
field simply hides it. Writes land as minimal `settings.mutate` path ops, so
the redacted API-key secret is never rewritten.

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · Layout：- `src/index.ts` — Host loader entry (no host-side behavior).
- `src/invariant.ts` — package invariant companion (no runtime invariant).
- `src/client/index.ts` — browser half: registers the `settings.section` entry,
  wires the zh/en copy dictionaries to the active locale, and injects the
  `connection.api` wire face + bound translate into the section.
- `src/client/ModelAdvancedSection.tsx` — the settings page component.
- `src/client/schema-probe.ts` — pure schema-introspection and draft-editing
  helpers.
- `src/client/locales.ts` — zh/en copy dictionaries.
- `src/client/ModelAdvancedSection.module.css` — theme-token styles.

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · Build：```powershell
corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace
corepack pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
corepack pnpm run build
```

The client bundle registers itself via
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, "@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced", factory })`
and injects its stylesheet as a `<style data-plugin-css>` tag at factory
evaluation.

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · Install (separate step)：```powershell
pnpm pack --pack-destination <profile>\packages
node <checkout>\apps\cli\lib\bin.js plugin --profile web add -w <abs path to .tgz>
```

Because the package ships `dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh plugin add` reconciles the
bundle stack and mounts the row — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` edit. Client
bundles need a host restart to enter the bundle stack.

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · 目录结构：- `src/index.ts` — Host 加载器入口（无 Host 端行为）。
- `src/invariant.ts` — 包的 invariant 伴生文件（无运行时 invariant）。
- `src/client/index.ts` — 浏览器端：注册 `settings.section` 条目，将中英文文案字典绑定到当前语言环境，并把 `connection.api` 连线面（wire face）及绑定的翻译函数注入到设置区块。
- `src/client/ModelAdvancedSection.tsx` — 设置页组件。
- `src/client/schema-probe.ts` — 纯 schema 内省与草稿编辑辅助函数。
- `src/client/locales.ts` — 中英文文案字典。
- `src/client/ModelAdvancedSection.module.css` — 主题 token 样式。

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · 构建：```powershell
corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace
corepack pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
corepack pnpm run build
```

客户端 bundle 通过
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, "@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced", factory })`
注册自身，并在 factory 求值时以 `<style data-plugin-css>` 标签注入样式表。

@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-settings-model-advanced README · 安装（独立步骤）：```powershell
pnpm pack --pack-destination <profile>\packages
node <checkout>\apps\cli\lib\bin.js plugin --profile web add -w <abs path to .tgz>
```

由于包内自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh plugin add` 会自动协调 bundle 栈并挂载对应条目，无需手动编辑 `cordis.patch.yml`。客户端 bundle 需要重启 Host 才能进入 bundle 栈。
